mapper.insert: insert into RSK_COM_RED_FEE_EXP_COND(PORTFOLIO_ID, CDATE, CASH_BOND_PERCENT, DEVIATION_DEGREE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select pv.PORTFOLIO_ID, pv.CDATE, rv.SUP_VAL*100, pv.DEVIATION_DEGREE, 'system', null, sysdate, 'system', sysdate from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION pv left join RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL rv on ((pv.PORTFOLIO_ID = rv.PORTFOLIO_ID or rv.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select rd.PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL rd where rd.PORTFOLIO_ID = pv.PORTFOLIO_ID and rd.PORTFOLIO_ID not in ( select rv1.PORTFOLIO_ID from RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL rv1 where rv1.IND_ID = #{indID} and rv1.SUP_DATE = #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} and rv1.SUP_FREQUENCY='DAYEND' ))) and rv.SUP_DATE = #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} and rv.IND_ID = #{indID} and rv.SUP_FREQUENCY='DAYEND' ) where pv.CDATE = #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by pv.PORTFOLIO_ID asc
